apps.name: HyperLink
apps.subtitle: Chat with local AI models on your device
apps.localizedDescription: HyperLink is an iOS companion app that lets you chat with AI models running on your local machine. Connect over your home network or remotely via Tailscale. Send photos, upload files and code, and resolve Hugging Face GGUF links into real downloads.

### HyperLink

The attached `HyperLink-*.ipa` is the companion iPhone app —
chat with the models on your own machine, over the LAN or a
tailnet. It is **unsigned** unless this release was built with
signing secrets, so install it with AltStore, Sideloadly, or a
free Xcode profile. Verify it against `SHA256SUMS.ios`.

No IPA attached means the app build did not run this time; the
Python package is unaffected.
